analyze-with-item.json.rule: a job carries no platform data (ADR-0003; Q6)

analyze-with-provenance.json.rule: a job carries no provenance (ADR-0003; Q6)

candidate-retry-with-text.json.rule: a job carries ids and the client's terms, no platform text (ADR-0003)

carries-priority.json.rule: priority, route and vendor never travel in a job (ADR-0011, ADR-0018)

carries-route.json.rule: priority, route and vendor never travel in a job (ADR-0011, ADR-0018)

carries-vendor.json.rule: priority, route and vendor never travel in a job (ADR-0011, ADR-0018)

comments-thread-ids.json.rule: a comments, metrics or first_sight job reads the whole item, never thread_ids (plan L415; ADR-0011)

export-not-admin.json.rule: the admin API sends export jobs (ADR-0067 L26; Q13)

first-check-without-host.json.rule: a first check names its host (ADR-0022)

first-sight-id-list.json.rule: one video per first_sight job (ADR-0065 a))

first-sight-thread-ids.json.rule: a comments, metrics or first_sight job reads the whole item, never thread_ids (plan L415; ADR-0011)

hashtag-without-edge.json.rule: an ig-hashtag-search job names its edge (F-27)

keyword-history-ops-reason.json.rule: a keyword history runs on add or client (ADR-0064, ADR-0059)

kind-not-on-queue.json.rule: a kind with no row on a queue leaves it (ADR-0012)

manual-without-request.json.rule: a manual candidate names its request (ADR-0066)

metrics-comment-step.json.rule: a metrics step is +24h, +7d or refresh:<request_id> (ADR-0034)

metrics-thread-ids.json.rule: a comments, metrics or first_sight job reads the whole item, never thread_ids (plan L415; ADR-0011)

missing-partition-key.json.rule: a job carries its queue's key (ADR-0004)

ops-force-unknown-requester.json.rule: a requester that names a service is one the registry lists (Q18; F-09)

ops-force-without-request.json.rule: the admin API's ops_force names its request (ADR-0012 L34)

produced-at-february-30.json.rule: message times are calendar times from 0001 to 9999 (note 18)

producer-not-allowed.json.rule: the producer table has no row for this queue, kind and service (ADR-0012)

purge-refresh-without-deadline.json.rule: a refresh before a purge carries its deadline (ADR-0065 e))

push-due-at-not-received.json.rule: a push job is due when received (ADR-0011)

recheck-person-requester.json.rule: a recheck names the service whose host gate asked, never a person (ADR-0040)

recheck-unknown-requester.json.rule: a recheck's requester is a service the registry lists (F-09)

recheck-without-requester.json.rule: a recheck names the service that asked (ADR-0022)

recompute-range-without-from.json.rule: the admin API's recompute names its range (ADR-0012 L34)

rematch-without-window.json.rule: a rematch names its window (keyword-matcher §5.3 H)

replay-unknown-requester.json.rule: a requester that names a service is one the registry lists (Q18; F-09)

replay-without-requester.json.rule: a replay names who asked (ADR-0012 L34)

replies-window-start.json.rule: a replies job off jobs.x-full-archive-search names its threads, not a window (plan L425)

replies-without-thread-ids.json.rule: a replies job lists its threads (ADR-0060)

resolve-without-identity.json.rule: a resolve job names the account by id, handle or url (ADR-0032)

resolver-without-candidate-key.json.rule: a resolve job carries its candidate key (ADR-0032)

retention-sweep-without-cutoff.json.rule: a sweep names its cutoff (yt-text-purger §5.1 L44)

review-answer-unknown-action.json.rule: the action is one of the card's buttons (qualifier §5.3 L67)

tier-true.json.rule: a constant keeps its JSON type: 0 is not false and true is not 1 (finding 6)

x-gap-with-reason.json.rule: a reconciliation names a reason on yt-uploads-reconciler's queue only; the X gap job none (plan L421; ADR-0064 L25)

x-gap-without-window.json.rule: the X gap job names its window (ADR-0064)

x-replies-thread-ids.json.rule: an X replies job reads a window rather than thread_ids (plan L425; ADR-0060 L32)

x-replies-without-window.json.rule: an X replies job names its window (ADR-0064)
